questions.qtext:
The bandwidth required for the frequency modulated signal is
(Assume fm is the maximum frequency present in the message signal)
questions.solution:
(d)
• Ideally, for frequency modulated signal, requirement of bandwidth is infinite.
• The bandwidth required to obtain the most significant sidebands in the FM signal is given by Carson’s rule as BW = (β + 1)2fm.
Since, here nothing is mentioned. Therefore by default we assume for ideal case. Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.qtext:
Consider the following statements about superheterodyne receiver:
(a) IF used in AM receiver is 455 kHz.
(b) IF used in FM receiver is 10.7 kHz.
(c) The bandwidth of IF amplifier in AM is 10 kHz.
(d) The bandwidth of IF amplifier in FM is 200 Hz.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(a, c)
The bandwidth of a single channel for an FM radio is 200 kHz. So, the bandwidth of IF amplifier
in FM is 200 kHz. Hence, option (d) is not correct.
